method:
Build exact native source-art comparisons for all sixty enemy proposals.

These are labelled SOURCE pose boards, not mGBA footage or AI simulations.
Each authored pose is held for the same review duration, independently of
gameplay timing. The real-run gallery and combat traces are separate evidence.
provenance_note: Actual source inputs are pinned by SHA256 below. The git base can predate uncommitted authoring files; ROM freeze/capture provenance is separate.

palette_policy.protected_shared_bank: Original bugs/foliage remains unchanged for cloak and carried bushes.
palette_policy.basis: 120 source comparisons on actual background crops; distinct from new actual mGBA evidence.

notes: A hollow cup on greasy feet; the planted gait accelerates with the existing chase clock. The handle and black rim stay readable.
A pale root with a thorn-leaf crown; alternating forked roots expose its approach direction. No armored crown is implied.
An abandoned boot walks itself toward Bloom; the sole flexes while its open ankle and toe keep a clear silhouette.
A living brass buckle shuffles on crab legs; asymmetric pincers open the silhouette without implying a separate ranged attack.
A crusty loaf with a blunt biting end; underside feet alternate under a broad highlighted crust, keeping the moving body connected.
An acorn carried by thorn roots; the crown and tapered nut stay distinct while two roots plant in alternating positions.
A purse with a toothed seam and grasping legs; the brass latch is attached, rather than a floating loot sparkle.
A squat leaking inkpot crawls on bent nibs; the dark cavity, wide shoulder and glass reflection separate it from loose scenery.
A muddy toad with a broad plated brow; its left/right feet paddle alternately. The bright brow is decorative, not actual armor.
A dirty soap bar dragged by a slug; two eye stalks and a continuous dark underside distinguish the hunter from a dropped object.
A tiny living bell with insect wings; folded rest versus full wing extension communicates when the drifting pursuit is active.
A discarded glove flaps its fingers; fingers close around the palm during rest, never becoming separate flying particles.
A winged pair of teeth; a clamped resting jaw opens in flight. Its bite is contact damage, with no invented attack interval.
A rotted bowtie with an eye-bearing knot; cloth lobes lift and fold as wings while the knot remains the collision-bearing body.
A square lantern carried by two ragged wings; the handle and glowing central cavity remain attached through both flight poses.
A small fish skeleton swims through air; rib-fins open and draw inward around a continuous spine, with a folded resting tail.
A pale ribbon-like ray; broad flexible membranes alternate above/below the face and the trailing tail follows the same connected body.
A parasol fungus pulses its cap; the narrow closed rest silhouette becomes a broad canopy in flight. No new umbrella shielding is implied.
A moth made from dirty quills; pointed overlapping wing vanes open and fold while the small eye-bearing thorax stays stable.
A wheezing bagpipe flaps its bellows; three uneven pipes identify the creature even in its compressed resting pose.
Loop handle and broad belly identify the kettle; cheeks swell, the directional spout opens, then the body recoils.
Plump hen with tiny pumping legs; the bill contracts before a seed cough and projects in the real firing direction.
A pale, empty ceramic face on short rooted feet; the round mouth inflates and opens, with a visible top vent when north-facing.
A squat wooden organ on grub feet; the bellows rise and brass outlet opens after the inhalation.
An upright folded flower with a trumpet mouth; petals draw inward for charge and flare around the directional opening.
A living inverted umbrella walks on its handle and ribs; a central nozzle flexes as the canopy pulls in and snaps outward.
A broken pipe section with two dripping feet; the elbow points at the target and its seam bulges before discharge.
A curled shell supported by a fleshy sole; the short feeding tube contracts then flares in the actual firing direction.
A squat trumpet carried by four jointed feet; the round brass bell is the clear dangerous end, with no shield implication.
A box camera on two wooden legs; the lens draws in for charge and extends on release, never flashing like treasure.
The cap sits over accordion gills; the body compresses wide, extends tall on hop and folds again on landing.
A greasy wax pudding with a bent wick and drooping eye sockets; it pools, stretches and settles without implying fire damage.
A split walnut squeezes its root spring flat then extends it on hop; the shell seam is expressive, not an armored phase.
A loose molar waddles on two wet roots; the crown flattens into its socket and the roots trail during a leap.
A mouthy purse with leech feet; its broad clasp and angry face avoid looking like a passive coin pickup.
A snail in a living puddle; the shell pitches and the eye stalks fold before the whole animal hops.
An abandoned boot with two eyes in its cuff; its sole folds under the shaft then snaps long as it jumps.
A knotted handkerchief with a face in the fold; its corners pull inward, billow on hop and flatten on landing.
A pear-shaped swollen bladder with a pinched stem; the rubbery lower body spreads during charge and pulls tall in flight.
A dented bucket animated by scum; its handle folds, liquid compresses below the rim and its sludge feet extend during the hop.
A tarnished walking bell shifts its entire skirt before the clapper-blade cut. The exposed eye is identity, not an exclusive weak spot.
A cracked soup tureen plants its handles and tiny feet, draws back its ladle, then pours its weight into the strike.
A long-legged censer draws its chain-like arms close during preparation; the broad hot bowl pitches forward with its blade.
A stained molar roots itself on two bent root-legs. Its pale crown tilts back, then the whole tooth drives the chisel forward.
A sour-faced old boot winds its ankle, stamps through the cut and settles onto its heavy sole. The shoehorn is the weapon.
A folded moth leans its head and wing-cape together. Unequal wing panels make its front, back and side readable.
A carrying snail braces its soft lower body beneath a heavy coil. Its head recoils into the shell before swinging a reed blade.
A loose wooden puppet bends at shoulder, hip and knee. Its sword and wrist keep one grip while its wooden body counter-rotates.
A walking oyster opens a narrow dark mouth, shifts both shell lobes and thrusts a small shucking blade. Its shell is not a shield mechanic.
A soot-stained chandelier bends its central stem and candle crown into the cut. Flame highlights remain attached to candle tips.
A split gilded bell swells around its filthy sounding cavity. Its seam spreads before shots; its lower lip thrusts into a lunge.
A huge living chalice has a dark toothy bowl and sagging stem. The bowl fills during charge, opens for the volley and tips into pursuit.
A suspended silk stomach tightens its stitches before bursting from a central vent. Loose folds sag during recovery and split on death.
A ring of wet leech flesh cinches around a dark maw. The front head pulls back for a volley and stretches into a lunge.
A funereal bird opens an uneven fan before firing. Its hunched breast and drooping beak move together; the fan loses its spread during dying.
A serving platter carries a heaped wet body with three mouths. The pile rises before release, slumps after and tears apart during dying.
A choir of giant stained teeth compresses its gum base before a shot. Dark mouths open together; no individual tooth is an exclusive weak point.
A cratered face is pulled by a broken mainspring. Its jaw compresses for charge, springs open to release and leads the lunge.
An inverted flower bunch hangs from a fleshy stalk. Petals fold back to reveal its mouth; one immaculate bloom remains among sick tissue.
An ambulant bath carries a dripping, furious face in its scum. Its body rises over claw feet for a volley and pitches down during the lunge.
